accepted_findings.claim: _windowed_running_min discards the earlier value whenever a later value compares equal.

evidence_receipt.claim: _windowed_running_min discards the earlier value whenever a later value compares equal.
evidence_receipt.expected_stdout_contains:
while s and not s[-1][1] <= value:
    s.pop()
evidence_receipt.falsification_condition: If the code retained earlier values when a later value compared equal, the while loop would use '<' instead of '<=' in the comparison, or would otherwise preserve the earlier value. Here, 'not s[-1][1] <= value' is true when s[-1][1] > value, so the loop pops all values from the end of the deque whose value is greater than or equal to the new value, including those equal to it. Thus, when a new value compares equal to the last value, the earlier (equal) value is discarded.
